name: Onslow Tree Removal
description: Tree-service quote intake for homeowners in Jacksonville and Onslow County, North Carolina. Discovery card for AI agents: read-only service and service-area lookups are public at the URLs below; submitting a quote request requires an approved-partner bearer token. Homeowners without a token should use the web form at https://onslowtreeremoval.com/#request or call/text (910) 601-5667. Programmatic access is REST (see each skill); this card is for discovery.

skills.name: List tree services
skills.description: Returns the tree services offered (removal, trimming and pruning, stump grinding, lot and land clearing, emergency storm cleanup) with business contact info. Read-only, no authentication. GET https://onslowtreeremoval.com/api/connector/v1/services

skills.name: Check service area
skills.description: Confirms whether a homeowner's town is served (Jacksonville and Onslow County, NC: Jacksonville, Hubert, Richlands, Swansboro, Sneads Ferry, Holly Ridge, Midway Park, Verona). Read-only, no authentication. GET https://onslowtreeremoval.com/api/connector/v1/service-area

skills.name: Submit a tree-service quote request
skills.description: Submits a structured quote request (contact name, 10-digit US phone, email, address, service_id, urgency, details, optional photo). The only side effect is one lead email to the business inbox; a local reviewer follows up, usually within one business day. Requires an approved-partner bearer token as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Send dry_run:true to validate without creating a lead. POST https://onslowtreeremoval.com/api/connector/v1/quote-requests. Full schema: https://onslowtreeremoval.com/muse-connector/openapi.json
